description: This file contains Go source code implementing CEL validation rule compilation for Kubernetes API extensions, including environment setup, rule compilation, cost estimation, and size estimation.

classes.name: CompilationResult
classes.description: Represents the result of compiling a CEL validation rule, including the compiled program, errors, cost estimates, and related metadata.

classes.name: EnvLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading CEL environments for rules and message expressions based on environment set.

classes.name: alwaysNewEnvLoader
classes.description: Implementation of EnvLoader that always uses a provided function to load environments.

classes.name: sizeEstimator
classes.description: Estimates the size of AST nodes for cost calculations based on schema types.

methods.name: NewExpressionsEnvLoader
methods.description: Creates an EnvLoader that always uses the 'NewExpressions' environment.

methods.name: StoredExpressionsEnvLoader
methods.description: Creates an EnvLoader that always uses the 'StoredExpressions' environment.

methods.name: Compile
methods.description: Compiles CEL validation rules in a schema, returning compilation results for each rule.

methods.name: prepareEnvSet
methods.description: Prepares environment sets with variables for 'self' and 'oldSelf' based on schema type.

methods.name: compileRule
methods.description: Compiles an individual validation rule into a CEL program, estimating costs and handling message expressions.

methods.name: generateUniqueSelfTypeName
methods.description: Generates a unique placeholder type name for 'self' in CEL programs to prevent dependency on stable names.

methods.name: newCostEstimator
methods.description: Creates a new cost estimator for CEL expressions based on schema type.

methods.name: sizeEstimator.EstimateSize
methods.description: Estimates the size of an AST node for cost calculation based on schema type.

methods.name: sizeEstimator.EstimateCallCost
methods.description: Estimates the cost of a function call in CEL (not implemented, returns nil).

methods.name: maxCardinality
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of times data conforming to a schema's minimum size could exist in JSON.
